messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a simultaneous Python + TS SDK publish in tonight's 00:30-01:30 UTC change window. Plan: deploy-bot runs smoke canary (cohort=5%), then stagger dist-tag flip for the remaining cohorts. Need owners for publish, notes, and rollback.

maya: I can take PyPI publish + GPG signing. What's the package versioning scheme this round? :eyes: 

alex: version is 1.14.0 for both. Py builds are wheel/sdist. TS is npm package with `next` dist-tag during canary.

jonathan: I'll own npm publish and dist-tag flip. CI pipeline passes `npm publish --tag next` then `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.14.0 latest` on success.

rachel: I posted the release notes draft: https://docs.internal/release-notes/1.14.0 — can someone proof? also we need deprecation blurb for sync client.

alex: thanks rachel, quick edits done. Add a line about sync client deprecation and the migration guide link.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @alex for 2026-03-21T00:40:00Z. Canary cohort: 5% (random), timeout: 10m. Logs will be in #devex-publish.

maya: FYI, ensure twine is pinned to 3.8.0 in the release env. Last time we had signing failures with 3.9.

jonathan: noted. Also adding npm verification step: `npm pack` and `tar -tzf` smoke extract before publish.

ops-oncall: I'll standby and watch infra metrics during the window. Tag me if latency > 200ms p50 or error rate > 1%.

alex: Rollback criteria: checksum/signing mismatch, failed smoke canary, or postflip error spike (>1% errors or latency SLO breach). Rollback plan:

alex: 1) Remove npm dist-tag: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk latest`

alex: 2) Re-add previous dist-tag: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.13.5 latest`

alex: 3) For PyPI, if we must revert, we will push patched release and update docs; PyPI doesn't support deletion for orgs easily — we will publish 1.14.1 that reverts changes and mark 1.14.0 as yanked in release notes.

rachel: Add CI/telemetry links to runbook: https://ci.internal/builds/12345 and https://monitor.internal/dashboards/sdk-p50

maya: I'll publish wheels, sign, and upload. When done I'll post stamp and checksum: `sha256:abcd...1234`

jonathan: After I publish npm next, I'll wait 10m and then flip dist-tag if no alerts. I'll post the npm pack checksum here to cross-check.

alex: final: EMERGENCY contacts list — @ops-oncall, @maya, @jonathan, @alex. If anyone sees mismatch, call it out and we'll pause further flips. :thumbsup: 

rachel: lgtm. Good luck team.

deploy-bot: Canary completed for cohort=5% — no regressions observed. Next step queued: dist-tag flip in 5m.

alex: proceed with flip after 5m silence. If anything odd, abort and follow rollback.
